text: ### 6.2 精緻化アルゴリズム（MUST）
note: The six algorithm steps are expanded below; cycle-depth and exact root/GID formula coverage remains implicit.

text: Before a dynamic model request or static CLI render, the driver MUST run `ensurePlan()` (D-024). Fetch missing refs in parallel, store successful bodies in `$REINS_HOME/cas/<digest>`, record `content/fetched {ref, digest}`, rebuild `external` from logged content events and CAS, and retry elaboration until done. Components do not access this map directly.
note: No explicit acceptance exercises parallel retrieval, deadline, CAS reconstruction, and waiting across suspension.

text: The total wait is bounded by `suspenseTimeoutMs`, default 10000 ms; CLI accepts `--suspense-timeout`. Fetch failures and exceeded deadlines record `content/unavailable {ref, reason, detail?}`, where reason is timeout, not-found, denied, or error. Resolve unavailable refs to `[reins: content unavailable: <ref> (<reason>)]` and retry to done. Each node using this placeholder is accounted as degraded with reason `content-unavailable:<ref>`. The used-ref digest map includes the digest of each materialized placeholder. Missing content MUST NOT be silently rendered as an empty string.
note: Accounting and stable input are covered; timeout/failure placeholders and per-node degraded reasons lack explicit acceptance.

text: The hooks are `useLog(projection)`, `useTaskState()`, `useContent(ref)`, `useFile(path)`, and `useNamespace()` (types.ts `Hooks`). Calling them outside elaboration fails with `ELAB_HOOK_OUTSIDE_RENDER`. Hooks MUST NOT expose host information (I-ELAB-2).
note: No hook exposes host information.

text: 1. **Static lint (MUST):** `@reins/eslint-plugin`, implemented in `packages/eslint-plugin` in M1, checks harness components. It prohibits imports of I/O modules such as `node:fs`, `node:child_process`, and `node:net`; `process.env`; `Date`; `Math.random`; `fetch`; `crypto.getRandomValues`; and I/O outside the `@reins/core` hooks. `reins render` MUST run this lint on the harness package and fail with `ELAB_IMPURE` if it reports a violation.
note: Static lint and double elaboration have separate tests.

text: - Projection<T>, useLog<T>, and project<T> do not require a Json generic constraint. Development mode MUST check projection state for JSON serializability at runtime (D-044).
note: Unconstrained generic projection state is checked at runtime.

text: ### 7.2 ホスト調停（MUST）
note: Ownership, drift, and record location are covered; atomic writes, deletion, and concurrency need explicit criteria.

text: Static host commits to the same workspace MUST be serialized by an exclusive lock at `$REINS_HOME/state/<wsid>/lock`. Hold it across observation, ownership/drift checks, writes, and CommitRecord updates. Fail with `LOCKED` after 30 seconds without acquiring it (D-037).
note: No explicit acceptance for mutual exclusion across observation/write/record or the 30-second LOCKED deadline.

text: Before multi-host commits, duplicate planned targets MUST fail the entire plan with TARGET_CONFLICT. When Codex is configured via-agents-md, it emits no AGENTS.md or shared skills and avoids those duplicates (D-064).
note: Duplicate targets fail; Codex co-host mode omits shared targets.

text: 書き込みは一時ファイル + rename で原子的に行う（MUST）。
note: No explicit acceptance asserts temporary-file-plus-rename writes, including interrupted writes.

text: Volatility is a placement contract. Static/session nodes may change during a Run and the host MUST use the updated content. `render/committed.cacheBreak` is true when the system portion changes, and false otherwise. I-RENDER-4 still requires identical system outputs when only turn nodes differ (D-032).
note: Turn-only stability is covered; changed static/session content and cacheBreak toggling are not explicitly tested.

text: MCP environment references MUST use the destination's supported reference syntax, never resolved secret values. S-2 and S-3 MUST verify expansion support for every configuration target in this table. A destination without supported expansion drops the affected tool with reason `secret-unsupported` (D-034).
note: Expansion support is covered; non-disclosure and secret-unsupported drop behavior need explicit tests.

section: ### 8.3 真偽調停（アンカー評価）
text: Command anchors MUST NOT execute in the real workspace (D-040). For git snapshots, create a temporary worktree from the snapshot commit, apply the recorded working-tree diff, execute, and remove the worktree afterward. For non-git snapshots, copy to a temporary directory and remove it afterward; above 1 GiB, report unverifiable with reason `too-large`.
note: No explicit acceptance verifies command-anchor isolation, cleanup, recorded dirty diff, or >1 GiB behavior.

text: - A git package with uncommitted changes MUST fail proposal application with DIRTY_PACKAGE. Successful application creates a `reins: apply proposal <id>` commit. Evolvers may write only candidate copies under `$REINS_HOME/candidates/<id>/`, never the canonical package (D-050).
note: Candidate-only writes are covered; dirty-package rejection and exact Git commit behavior have no explicit acceptance.

text: ### 9.1 CapSet 演算（MUST、core に実装）
note: Capability operations are specified under this header.

text: - `attenuate(parent, req, opts?)`: for each requested Grant g, intersect g.rights with the union of rights of parent Grants whose patterns contain g.on. RefPattern containment is conservative glob containment (`**` ⊇ `*` ⊇ literal); an undecidable containment is treated as false. Budget fields use min, with omitted fields inheriting the parent value. `opts.strict` defaults to false, which silently attenuates. With `{ strict: true }`, any attenuation throws `CAP_WIDENING`. Session mount MUST pass `{ strict: true }` (D-022).
note: Strict mount narrowing rejects; ordinary attenuation stays monotone.

text: - Every log's seq 0 MUST be run/start. Any other initial kind fails with LOG_CORRUPT (D-066).
note: Corrupt initial kind and hash chain must fail.

text: | session/intent send | Record session/status unknown and notify the human. Delivery cannot be established, so MUST NOT automatically resend. |
note: Recovery is required, but no explicit acceptance distinguishes a crash after pre-send logging from successful delivery and tests no automatic resend.

text: The LLM MUST NOT construct an arbitrary child harness or supply arbitrary runtime/caps through session_spawn (D-041). `PackageManifest.sessionProfiles[name]` declares an entry-module component export, allowed runtime kinds, and caps. Select the child's harness from that export and attenuate profile caps against the requester's caps. Authors do not need to include RequestedSessions manually.
note: Profile selection is exercised; rejection of LLM-supplied arbitrary harness/runtime/caps is not explicit.

section: ## 3. 動的ホスト `dsh` の写像（MUST）
text: **Plan preparation and caching:** before a model request, run asynchronous ensurePlan(). If elaborate returns suspended, fetch missing refs in parallel, store successful bodies in `$REINS_HOME/cas/<digest>`, record content/fetched, rebuild external from content events/CAS, and retry (D-024). At the suspenseTimeoutMs deadline (default 10000), or on fetch failure, record content/unavailable and resolve the specified placeholder. Affected nodes are degraded with reason `content-unavailable:<ref>`. Requests MUST wait for done; synchronous text providers use only the completed plan.
note: See MUST-010/011 for suspension, deadline, and degraded-node acceptance gaps.

Section/context providers are synchronous memo readers. S-5 MUST verify PromptAssembly structure and replacement support; unavailable replacement makes M0 BLOCKED (D-055). Names are exactly reins:static, reins:session, and reins:turn, scoped by registration (D-061).
